description: Predict replication origin and terminus from cumulative GC-skew extrema: origin ~ prefix index of the minimum, terminus ~ prefix index of the maximum; also returns all minimizing/maximizing indices (Rosalind BA1F) and supports a circular flag (positions mod n). Best on complete circular bacterial genomes.

circular.description: Treat the input as a circular chromosome: prefix index n = junction 0, positions reported mod n in [0, n-1]

originPositions.description: All prefix indices minimizing the cumulative skew (Rosalind BA1F answer), ascending

terminusPositions.description: All prefix indices maximizing the cumulative skew, ascending

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
